verdict.rationale: Fireworks' own site describes a guided fine-tuning flow where the user describes the task, reviews a generated plan and cost, and approves the run. That is first-party natural-language operation of one product workflow. Tool calling and structured outputs are developer building blocks for apps built on the models, not ways to operate Fireworks itself, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: natural-language control beyond fine-tuning (deployments, models, billing), in-depth documentation of the guided flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Get a guided path. Describe the task, review the plan and cost, approve the run, and get a trained model.
